svg.text: Make 2, identical. Plate 92 x 60 mm with a 32.8 mm hole in the middle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each 92 mm edge: a tab in the middle and a T-slot 30 mm either side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T-slot: 9 mm wide, 23 deep, with a 13.6 x 8.4 mm window 10 mm in for the nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the saddles sit across the spine at right angles to the 73 degree

svg.text: seat line, 100 mm apart along it; the seat tube passes through both

svg.text: and a shaft collar bears on the outside face of each.
